scripts.test: pnpm -r test && uv run --directory services/server pytest
scripts.check: biome check . && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm check:api && uv run --directory services/server ruff check
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory services/server python -m tassel.scripts.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @tassel/shared exec openapi-typescript src/api/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts
